title: Vitryne format v1: fabrics/<id>.json
description: A fabric's physical behaviour, in SI units, independent of mesh resolution and of the solver. Appearance (colour, texture) is a separate entity, added later. 'Warp' is the grain line direction of the piece, 'weft' perpendicular to it in the fabric plane.

category.description: Construction. Quality targets differ (docs/history: woven p99 strain < 3%, knit < 8%).

thickness.description: Fabric thickness, mm. Optional; not used by the v1 engine (its collision thickness is a simulation setting).

stretch.description: In-plane tensile stiffness, N/m (force per unit width per unit strain). shear: in-plane shear stiffness, N/m.

bending.description: Bending rigidity per unit width, N·m (moment per unit width per unit curvature), for bending lines across the warp, across the weft, and on the bias (optional; defaults to the mean of warp and weft).

friction.description: Coulomb friction coefficient against the body (dimensionless).

notes.description: Where the values come from (measurement, datasheet, paper) or that they're placeholders.
